items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: some colored fellow friend of ours brought a part of Dan Garber's orchestra out.

ctx.x: Is that so? It was, uh, well into the depression before you, uh,

Yeah. Back in that kind of work. Yeah. Correct. By 34, cause that's, that's, uh, that's back when I went to the Panama, see, when, uh-huh. I didn't go, I didn't go directly back. I quit. And, uh, this piano, it has history behind it. Everybody that came to Chicago played on this piano. Duke, we had a little tea room around the corner when we lived around there during the depression. And, uh, Duke Ellington, Earl Hines, all the performers that came to Chicago at that time came to our place. At one time, uh, some…
This was the place on Indiana Avenue?
